<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#1E2A4A;
    --navy-light:#2B3A61;
    --coral:#E8734A;
    --coral-light:#F2A184;
    --coral-tint:#FFF3EE;
    --paper:#F7F7F5;
    --ink:#232A3B;
    --muted:#767F94;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{height:100%;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    background:#12182b;
    color:var(--ink);
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:20px;
  }
  .deck{
    width:100%;
    max-width:980px;
    aspect-ratio:16/9;
    background:#fff;
    border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .deck-logo{
    position:absolute; top:16px; right:20px; z-index:5;
    background:#fff; padding:7px 14px; border-radius:9px;
    box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
    display:flex; align-items:center;
  }
  .deck-logo img{height:32px; display:block;}
  .slide{
    position:absolute;
    top:0; right:0; bottom:0; left:0;
    padding:34px 54px;
    display:none;
    flex-direction:column;
    justify-content:center;
    opacity:0;
    transform:translateX(24px);
    transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
    overflow:auto;
  }
  .slide::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:5px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--coral) 0%, var(--coral-light) 100%);
  }
  .slide.title-slide::before{display:none;}
  .slide.active{display:flex; opacity:1; transform:translateX(0);}
  .kicker{
    font-size:12px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.13em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:7px;
  }
  h1{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:50.5px; font-weight:800; margin:0 0 12px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.12; letter-spacing:-.01em;}
  h2{font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:25.5px; font-weight:700; margin:0 0 11px; color:var(--navy);}
  h3{font-size:14.5px; margin:0 0 4px; color:var(--navy); font-weight:700;}
  p.lede{font-size:15.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 6px; line-height:1.5;}
  p.note{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:7px;}

  .title-slide{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-light) 100%); color:#fff; position:relative;}
  .title-slide::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; right:-120px; top:-120px; width:420px; height:420px;
    border-radius:50%; background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,115,74,.16) 0%, rgba(232,115,74,0) 70%);
  }
  .title-slide h1{color:#fff; font-size:53px; font-weight:800;}
  .title-slide .accent{color:var(--coral-light);}
  .title-slide p.lede{color:#C7CCDA; font-size:18px;}
  .badge{margin-top:22px; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; color:#fff; letter-spacing:.01em;}
  .badge .sub{display:block; font-weight:400; font-size:14px; color:#9AA3BC; margin-top:2px;}
  .title-slide .deck-logo{background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);}

  .callout{border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; margin:9px 0;}
  .callout.navy{background:var(--navy); color:#fff;}
  .callout.navy .tag{color:var(--coral-light); font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; margin-bottom:5px;}
  .callout.navy p{margin:0; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5;}
  .callout.def{background:var(--paper); border-left:4px solid var(--navy); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}
  .callout.warn{background:var(--coral-tint); border-left:4px solid var(--coral); font-size:13px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}

  .bullets{list-style:none; margin:9px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .bullets li{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink); padding:5px 0 5px 22px; position:relative; line-height:1.4;}
  .bullets li::before{content:"•"; position:absolute; left:2px; color:var(--coral); font-size:18.5px; line-height:1;}

  .pkgcard{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:14px; margin-top:6px;}
  .pkgicon{flex-shrink:0; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:Georgia,serif; font-weight:800; font-size:18.5px;}
  .pkgtext{font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}

  .taskcard{background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E2E2DE; border-left:4px solid var(--navy); border-radius:8px; padding:13px 16px; margin:8px 0;}
  .taskcard .ttag{font-size:11px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:6px;}
  .taskcard .ttext{font-size:15px; line-height:1.55; color:var(--ink);}
  .taskcard.promptcard{border-left-color:var(--coral); background:var(--coral-tint);}
  .taskcard.promptcard .ttag{color:var(--coral);}

  .codewrap{position:relative; margin:6px 0;}
  .codebox{background:#1c2440; color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 54px 10px 13px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; overflow-x:auto;}
  .codebox .cm{color:#7d89ab;}
  .codecopybtn{position:absolute; top:7px; right:7px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.10); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); color:#dfe6f5; border-radius:6px; padding:4px 9px; font-size:11.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .codecopybtn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);}
  .codecopybtn.copied{background:var(--coral); border-color:var(--coral); color:#fff;}
  .errorbox{background:#2b1a20; color:#f3b4b4; border-left:4px solid var(--coral); border-radius:8px; padding:11px 14px; font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",monospace; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; margin-top:8px; white-space:pre-wrap;}
  .errorbox .taglabel{display:block; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--coral-light); margin-bottom:6px;}

  .datasetgrid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:7px;}
  .datasetcard{flex:1 1 40%; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:10px 13px; box-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.03);}
  .datasetcard .badge2{font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.07em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--coral); margin-bottom:4px;}
  .datasetcard .file{font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--navy); margin-bottom:2px; font-weight:700;}
  .datasetcard .meta2{font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5;}

  .cols2{display:flex; gap:12px; margin-top:6px;}
  .oscard{flex:1; background:var(--paper); border:1px solid #E7E7E2; border-radius:10px; padding:11px 14px;}

  .checklist{list-style:none; margin:10px 0 0; padding:0;}
  .checklist li{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; font-size:15px; margin-bottom:8px; color:var(--ink); line-height:1.4;}
  .checklist .num{flex-shrink:0; width:20px; height:20px; margin-right:10px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;}

  .navbar{width:100%; max-width:980px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:14px; color:#C7CCDA; font-size:14.5px;}
  .navbar .btns{display:flex; gap:8px;}
  .navbtn{background:#1c2440; border:1px solid #333d5c; color:#fff; border-radius:8px; padding:7px 15px; font-size:14.5px; cursor:pointer;}
  .navbtn:hover{background:#2b3660;}
  .navbtn:disabled{opacity:.35; cursor:default;}
  .progress{font-size:13px; color:#8b93ad;}
</style>

<div class="deck" id="deck">

  <div class="deck-logo"><img src="eppslogo.png" alt="UTD EPPS logo"></div>

  <div class="slide active title-slide">
    <div class="kicker">EPPS Math &amp; Coding Camp</div>
    <h1>Data Manipulation<br>with the <span class="accent">Tidyverse</span></h1>
    <p class="lede">dplyr, janitor, tidyr, and broom — cleaning, summarizing, and comparing real data.</p>
    <div class="badge">JP Adjadeh<span class="sub">EPPS, UT Dallas</span></div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <img src="check_in_form.png" alt="Attendance check-in QR code" style="width:220px; height:220px; display:block; margin:auto;">
  </div>


  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before You Start</div>
    <h2>What's the tidyverse?</h2>
    <div class="callout def">A collection of R packages built around a shared, verb-based grammar for working with data. Where base R uses bracket indexing — <code>data[row, column]</code> — the tidyverse uses named functions like <code>select()</code>, <code>filter()</code>, and <code>mutate()</code>, chained together in a readable sequence.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Before You Start</div>
    <h2>The pipe: |&gt;</h2>
    <div class="callout def">The native pipe <code>|&gt;</code> takes what's on its left and feeds it as the first argument to what's on its right. <code>life_exp |&gt; filter(...)</code> reads as "take life_exp, then filter it."</div>
    <div class="callout warn">You'll also see <code>%&gt;%</code> in older tutorials and Stack Overflow answers — same idea, from the magrittr package rather than base R. We'll use <code>|&gt;</code> today.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Package 1 of 4</div>
    <h2>dplyr</h2>
    <div class="pkgcard">
      <div class="pkgicon">d</div>
      <div class="pkgtext">The core grammar of data manipulation. A small set of verbs — <code>select()</code>, <code>filter()</code>, <code>arrange()</code>, <code>mutate()</code>, <code>summarize()</code> — cover most of what indexing and subsetting did in base R.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Point and click</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:0;">Packages pane (bottom right) → Install → type "dplyr" → Install</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>By code</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c1" style="font-size:12px;">p_load(dplyr)</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy="p_load(dplyr)" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 1</div>
    <h2>select()</h2>
    <div class="datasetgrid"><div class="datasetcard"><div class="badge2">Now Using</div><div class="file">life_exp</div></div></div>
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using the dplyr package and the pipe (|&gt;), write R code to select only the Year, Gender, and Average_Life_Expectancy columns from life_exp.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Naming the columns you want</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c2">life_exp |&gt; select(Year, Gender, Average_Life_Expectancy)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> select(Year, Gender, Average_Life_Expectancy)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 1, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c2-r">life_exp |&gt; select(Year, Gender, Average_Life_Expectancy)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> select(Year, Gender, Average_Life_Expectancy)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Now that you've seen this work, write an AI prompt that would get you to this same code. Compare what the AI gives you to what you already wrote.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 2</div>
    <h2>filter()</h2>
    
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using dplyr and the pipe (|&gt;), write R code to filter life_exp to only rows where Gender is "Female."</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Keeping rows that match</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c3">life_exp |&gt; filter(Gender == "Female")</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> filter(Gender == "Female")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 2, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c3-r">life_exp |&gt; filter(Gender == "Female")</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> filter(Gender == "Female")' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Now that you've seen this work, write an AI prompt that would get you to this same code. Compare what the AI gives you to what you already wrote.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 3</div>
    <h2>arrange()</h2>
    
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using dplyr and the pipe (|&gt;), write R code to arrange life_exp by Average_Life_Expectancy from highest to lowest. Identify which year and gender had the highest value.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Sorting with desc()</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c4">life_exp |&gt; arrange(desc(Average_Life_Expectancy))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> arrange(desc(Average_Life_Expectancy))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 3, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c4-r">life_exp |&gt; arrange(desc(Average_Life_Expectancy))</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp |> arrange(desc(Average_Life_Expectancy))' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Now that you've seen this work, write an AI prompt that would get you to this same code. Compare what the AI gives you to what you already wrote.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 4</div>
    <h2>group_by() + summarize()</h2>
    
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using dplyr and the pipe (|&gt;), write R code to group life_exp by Gender and compute the average Average_Life_Expectancy for each group. This is your first real summary table — print it, and save it to your working directory as a CSV.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Your first summary table</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c5" style="font-size:10.5px;">life_exp_summary &lt;- life_exp |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;group_by(Gender) |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;summarize(mean_life_exp = mean(Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))<br>print(life_exp_summary)<br>write.csv(life_exp_summary, "life_exp_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp_summary <- life_exp |>
  group_by(Gender) |>
  summarize(mean_life_exp = mean(Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))
print(life_exp_summary)
write.csv(life_exp_summary, "life_exp_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <p class="note">group_by() + summarize() is the pattern behind almost every summary table you'll build from here on.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr — Task 4, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c5-r" style="font-size:10.5px;">life_exp_summary &lt;- life_exp |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;group_by(Gender) |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;summarize(mean_life_exp = mean(Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))<br>print(life_exp_summary)<br>write.csv(life_exp_summary, "life_exp_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='life_exp_summary <- life_exp |>
  group_by(Gender) |>
  summarize(mean_life_exp = mean(Average_Life_Expectancy, na.rm = TRUE))
print(life_exp_summary)
write.csv(life_exp_summary, "life_exp_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Now that you've seen this work, write an AI prompt that would get you to this same code. Compare what the AI gives you to what you already wrote.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Package 2 of 4</div>
    <h2>janitor</h2>
    <div class="pkgcard">
      <div class="pkgicon">j</div>
      <div class="pkgtext">Practical cleaning utilities dplyr doesn't include. <code>clean_names()</code> converts inconsistent column names into a consistent format automatically. <code>tabyl()</code> gives quick frequency counts.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="cols2">
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>Point and click</h3>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:0;">Packages pane → Install → type "janitor" → Install</p>
      </div>
      <div class="oscard">
        <h3>By code</h3>
        <div class="codewrap">
          <div class="codebox" id="c6" style="font-size:12px;">p_load(janitor)</div>
          <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy="p_load(janitor)" onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="datasetgrid"><div class="datasetcard"><div class="badge2">Now Using</div><div class="file">air</div></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">janitor — Task 1</div>
    <h2>clean_names()</h2>
    
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using the janitor package, write R code to clean up air's column names so they're consistent. Check names(air) before and after.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Consistent names, automatically</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c7">names(air)<br>air &lt;- air |&gt; clean_names()<br>names(air)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='names(air)
air <- air |> clean_names()
names(air)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <p class="note">Type_Name becomes type_name, Data.Value becomes data_value — every column now follows the same pattern.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">janitor — Task 1, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c7-r">names(air)<br>air &lt;- air |&gt; clean_names()<br>names(air)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='names(air)
air <- air |> clean_names()
names(air)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    <div class="taskcard promptcard">
      <div class="ttag">Now Prompt It</div>
      <div class="ttext">Now that you've seen this work, write an AI prompt that would get you to this same code. Compare what the AI gives you to what you already wrote.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr on air — Task 5</div>
    <h2>Chaining filter, group, and summarize</h2>
    
    <div class="taskcard trycard">
      <div class="ttag">Your Task</div>
      <div class="ttext">Using dplyr and the pipe (|&gt;), write R code to filter air to rows where type_name is "UHF42," then group by name and compute the average data_value for each. Print the result and save it to your working directory as a CSV.</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">Check Your Code</div>
    <h2>Three verbs, one pipeline</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c8" style="font-size:10px;">air_summary &lt;- air |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;filter(type_name == "UHF42") |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;group_by(name) |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;summarize(avg_value = mean(data_value))<br>print(air_summary)<br>write.csv(air_summary, "air_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='air_summary <- air |>
  filter(type_name == "UHF42") |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarize(avg_value = mean(data_value))
print(air_summary)
write.csv(air_summary, "air_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)' onclick="copyCode(this)">Copy</button>
    </div>
    
  </div>

  <div class="slide">
    <div class="kicker">dplyr on air — Task 5, Prompted</div>
    <h2>Now try the prompt</h2>
    <div class="codewrap">
      <div class="codebox" id="c8-r" style="font-size:10px;">air_summary &lt;- air |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;filter(type_name == "UHF42") |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;group_by(name) |&gt;<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;summarize(avg_value = mean(data_value))<br>print(air_summary)<br>write.csv(air_summary, "air_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)</div>
      <button class="codecopybtn" data-copy='air_summary <- air |>
  filter(type_name == "UHF42") |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarize(avg_value = mean(data_value))

  <div class="progress" id="progress">1 / 48</div>
  <div class="btns">
    <button class="navbtn" id="prevBtn" onclick="go(-1)">Prev</button>
    <button class="navbtn" id="nextBtn" onclick="go(1)">Next</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  const slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
  let current = 0;

  function render(){
    slides.forEach((s, i) => s.classList.toggle('active', i === current));
    document.getElementById('prevBtn').disabled = current === 0;
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').disabled = current === slides.length - 1;
    document.getElementById('progress').textContent = (current+1) + ' / ' + slides.length;
  }

  function go(delta){
    const next = current + delta;
    if(next >= 0 && next < slides.length){ current = next; render(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if(e.key === 'ArrowRight') go(1);
    if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft') go(-1);
  });

  function copyCode(btn){
    const raw = btn.getAttribute('data-copy').replace(/\\n/g, '\n');
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(raw).then(() => {
      const original = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
      btn.classList.add('copied');
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = original; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1400);
    });
  }

  function sizeDeck(){
    const deck = document.getElementById('deck');
    deck.style.height = (deck.offsetWidth * 9 / 16) + 'px';
  }
  window.addEventListener('resize', sizeDeck);
  sizeDeck();

  render();
</script>
